title.suggested: Swindle Suspect Tracked to Tom Allen's Saloon

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that a detective spotted one of three suspected watch swindlers entering Tom Allen's saloon, leading to the arrest of all three men from Baltimore at a nearby boarding house.

metadata.notes: Same page as 512: 'The St. Louis Democrat', February 2, 1875.

notes: Allen's saloon is only the place a suspect was seen; no biographical fact about Allen.
